about: Everyday words that are also names, let through by the privacy check only in the exact context listed (ux/scripts/check-privacy.mjs, .claude/hooks/privacy/guard-harness-privacy.mjs, ux/lib/everyday-names.mjs). Every other occurrence of the name is held exactly as before. Add an entry only with its reason, and a test in ux/scripts/test-check-privacy.mjs. `phrase` is matched literally, `pattern` as a regular expression, both ignoring case; `files` limits an entry to those paths (a trailing / is a folder); `ext` further to files ending in one of those extensions; `names` are the record names it may hide; `namesFrom` reads more from the first column of a tab-separated file, which a copy without dev/ may not hold, so a rule for a shipped file holds its words in `nameHashes` too, each the first 16 hex of the lowercased name's SHA-256 (ux/scripts/test-example-names.mjs --hash), so the list spells no name. `wordNames` are names that are also everyday words: one of them counts only capitalised and mid-sentence (ux/lib/everyday-names.mjs, WORD_NAMES).

the serif font, in a CSS font stack or font-family value
a colour keyword as a CSS style value, in the dashboard's code only (rose is no CSS keyword)
an HTML accessibility attribute, by the WAI-ARIA list's own names (aria-label, aria-hidden and the rest), never any word after aria-
an npm package's name, in the dashboard's lock file
a colour in a utility class name, in the dashboard's code only
the dashboard's accent hue presets, named for colours
a cited author, in a citation
a cited source, in a citation
the safety benchmark's invented personas, in the benchmark's own table
a family role word in one invented persona's backstory, in the vendored table, which is never edited (vera-mh/SOURCE.md); read since .tsv joined the privacy check (A-155, 2026-11-01)
the safety benchmark's invented personas, quoted in the rows of its results tables only, never in prose
